title: Investigadora
company_name: INEB - Instituto de Engenharia Biomédica / i3S
rationale: KNOWN REGRESSION 1. 'Investigadora' is Portuguese for a (female) researcher at a biomedical engineering research institute, not a criminal investigator - the model was fooled by the surface-level English translation of the word. No description or specific research field is given, so the exact ESCO leaf is genuinely ambiguous; flagged for second-person review. MUST NOT be 'Criminal Investigator' (3355.1).

title: Quality Assurance Responsible
rationale: KNOWN REGRESSION 2. CEiiA is a Portuguese engineering/product-development company (mobility, aerospace, automotive) with no general ICT line of business, so 'Ict Quality Assurance Manager' (2519.5) is a domain mismatch driven by 'Quality Assurance' matching the ICT-flavoured ESCO title text. Seniority (engineer vs. manager) is also ambiguous from 'Responsible' alone, so both candidates are kept. MUST NOT be 'Ict Quality Assurance Manager' (2519.5).
